decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing is close to the firm's established drainage know-how and was given its own page, so management is likely to keep it and learn its way up the material variant.
A floor-level shower drainage system sits at the heart of the firm's bathroom and renovation focus, making it highly compatible with existing knowledge and easy to improve commercially.
The designer shower drainage product directly matches the firm's design-conscious drainage positioning and was prominently presented, so it is very likely to be retained.
A shower element with integrated slope strongly supports the firm's promise of installation ease and integrated solutions, so its knowledge base should help management refine rather than abandon it.

The backflow-protected basement floor drain extends the firm's proven drainage technology into an adjacent application and the explicit launch communication suggests a serious commitment to the product.

The air-admittance valve is somewhat farther from the firm's core shower-drainage specialism than the other launches, but it still fits sanitary drainage systems closely enough that a capable engineering-led firm would likely keep it for now.
